info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Position Removal API
info.description: The Position Removal API facilitates the permanent deletion of specific positions within the banking account management system. This operation is essential for maintaining data integrity and compliance by allowing users to remove obsolete or incorrect entries efficiently. Typical consumers include auditors, financial analysts, and account managers who require clean and accurate data for reporting and operational purposes. By streamlining position management, this API helps organizations enhance their account oversight and improve decision-making processes.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a position identified by its unique resource ID, effectively removing it from the account management system.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting the position with ID RES-100045. This operation requires the necessary permissions to remove the specified position from the account management system.

201.description: The deletion request was successful, and the resource has been removed.
